principles: Sectional quad cages define fuselage, cowling, canopy and wing skins.
Subdivision is controlled by support loops and explicit creases only where the manufactured form requires them.
No visible hero surface may remain an unrefined primitive.
Separate animated or removable assemblies keep independent topology and pivots.
Boolean results must be retopologized at silhouette, shading or deformation-critical regions.
modifier_order: Mirror when reference symmetry is valid
Boolean cutters for real openings only
Weighted normal only after evaluated shading proves benefit

high_to_low_plan.cage_policy: Per-group named cages with recorded ray distances; no global unattended bake cage.
high_to_low_plan.bake_validation: Normal gradients, skew, waviness, seams and cage misses inspected under neutral grazing light.

unreal_plan.lod_requirement: At least four reviewed distance states or accepted Nanite equivalent; transparent and animated groups retain explicit LODs.
unreal_plan.collision: Simple UCX groups only; cosmetic microdetail has no collision.
